items.title: Mami Dan Temple of Toligbé Cultural Center / Maison Bignon Sossou
items.summary: Architecture as a Vessel for Living Heritage - The Mami Dan Temple of Toligbé reflects Maison Bignon Sossou's conviction that architecture can become a powerful medium for preserving, transmitting, and renewing Africa's living cultural heritage.

items.title: Public Art Company gives its LA studio a "muppets on acid" interior
items.summary: A system of curtains divides areas filled with collectible furniture within this compact office, which LA-based Public Art Company has designed for its own team.

items.title: Mimado Restaurant / García de Alba + Ponce Arquitectos
items.summary: Mimado is a restaurant in Temozón Norte, Mérida, where the interior carries the core identity of the project. The design transforms a double-height commercial space into a warm, layered environment defined by Art Deco references, green tile, white oak, vegetation, fluted glass, a mural made from recycled books, and a…

items.title: Cença Pizza Bar / IN arq+design
items.summary: Located in downtown Curitiba , the design of Cença Pizza Bar repurposes a previously underutilized historic building into a vibrant, welcoming, and character-filled bar — an environment that invites people to linger, discover, and socialize.

items.title: Lenka Milerová Architektka transforms stone pigsty in Czech Republic into holiday home
items.summary: Local studio Lenka Milerová Architektka has converted a former pigsty in the Czech Republic into Panoší Újezd Summer House, complementing its rough stone walls with additions in exposed concrete.

items.title: Apartment Interior within Poznań's Łazarz District / LBWA
items.summary: Designed by the LBWA studio, the apartment, located in a historic tenement building in the Łazarz district of Poznań , not only reflects the character of the historic structure but also introduces fresh, contemporary elements that give it a unique and functional character.

items.title: A Wooden Bench and the Geography of Materials
items.summary: Images of the benches at New York City's High Line Park spread around the world when the project opened in 2009. Emerging diagonally from the same material and modular pattern as the paving, they transition seamlessly from concrete to wood, evoking the railway tracks that once occupied the site.

items.title: Macchiato Pocket Park / OUT Architecture
items.summary: Macchiato is a public space designed by OUT Architecture for the London Festival of Architecture 2026, located in front of The Colombian Coffee Company along Petticoat Lane, one of London's most vibrant and culturally diverse streets.

items.title: The Nanshan Affiliated School of Beijing Normal University / Z&Z STUDIO
items.summary: Located in the coastal city of Shenzhen , the campus is envisioned as a "terraced courtyard campus" that harmoniously integrates mountain, park, and harbor landscapes.

items.title: Unfold Projects returns mid-century California residence to a "light-filled, organic oasis"
items.summary: American studio Unfold Projects has renovated a modernist home in Encinitas, California, that will serve as a base for an artist residency program.

items.title: Wildcoast Residence / Studio Kennon
items.summary: A house that does not resist the coast so much as negotiate with it. Positioned at the southern edge of the Mornington Peninsula, where the land yields to Bass Strait, the house inhabits a landscape of remarkable intensity.

items.title: O House / YES! Architects
items.summary: Casa O sits on a corner lot in a traditional neighborhood of Pilar. The project is conceived from a contrast between its south and north façades: one that builds hermeticism, the other that dematerializes it. The central pursuit is the construction of silence.

items.title: Casa Baruk Restaurant / Memola Estúdio
items.summary: Upon crossing the threshold of Casa Baruk in Higienópolis , São Paulo, the architecture reveals a meeting of traditions. The spatial sequence leads the visitor through an immersive experience, in which the perception of the environment expands in an almost tactile way, also echoing in the flavors that reach the table.

items.title: Sanduteca – Sandwich Library / Estúdio Cajalima
items.summary: The design of Sanduteca, located in Galeria Metrópole, grew out of the idea of creating a space that functions as a "library of flavors"—forming a small archive of tastes and seasonings from around the world.

items.title: Yano Aoyama Architecture Design tops public toilet in Japan with sweeping timber canopy
items.summary: Japanese practice Yano Aoyama Architecture Design has completed a public toilet for the Tobe Zoological Park in Ehime Prefecture, creating two chiselled concrete blocks that are topped by a thin roof of naturally curved cedar.
